title: Repository-host discovery pin race canary
mission: Verify the GitHub repository-host create-if-absent primitive for proposal fingerprint pins under concurrent attempts, preserving loser collision evidence and forbidding overwrite or authority promotion.

regression_prevention.reason: Can falsify whether concurrent surplus workers can create duplicate or overwriting proposal pins on the actual repository host.
